contexts.text: For stones iron = for sensuous truth natural truth. AC 1551:2.
Winged thing = sensuous truth. Sensuous truths, which are of the sight and hearing, being extreme, are called winged things.
Lot his brother's son = sensuous truth, thus the first which is insinuated into a child.

Sensuous truth is the first truth which insinuates itself; for in childhood the judgment goes no deeper. Sensuous truth is that he sees all earthly things as created by God; and each and all things for an end; and in each and all things some semblance of the Lord's Kingdom. This sensuous truth is not insinuated except with the celestial man; and, as the Lord alone was a celestial man, these and the like sensuous truths were insinuated into Him in His earliest childhood; and He was thus prepared to receive celestial things.
Divine good inflows... even into scientific and sensuous truths, which are scarcely anything else than fallacies; and conjoins itself with them...
Still lower truths... are scientific truths, and sensuous truths.
The exterior truth (in the Natural) is called sensuous truth. Representation.
The good of life from sensuous and scientific truths, Signified, Explained.
No one can be in scientific truths, unless he is first in sensuous truths; for the ideas of scientifics are procured from these. AC 3310:4.
Fishers = those who teach from sensuous truths.
Man cannot be regenerated until he is in doctrinals through sensuous and scientific truths. Explained.
Sons here = sensuous truths, which are so called because they are of sensuous things, and are the outermost ones of the natural mind.
External truths are those called sensuous truths, which inflow immediately from the world through the senses of the body.
New states which proceed... also to sensuous truths.
Sensuous truth, which is the most external, is signified by willows of the torrent.
Hoof = truth in the ultimate degree, thus sensuous truth...
Injury or loss of sensuous truth. Signified, Explained.
Garment, here, = sensuous truth, for this is the extreme or lowest.
A pledge, here, = sensuous truth...
The sea Suph = sensuous and scientific truths, which are the ultimate ones with man. Explained.
Best myrrh = the perception of sensuous truth. Explained.
Stacte = the affection of sensuous truth. Explained.
By ultimate truth... is meant sensuous truth, such as is the truth in the sense of the letter for those who are merely sensuous.
Divine truth of the fourth degree is that which arrives at the perception of the men of the Church... The ultimate of this is called Divine sensuous truth.
A reed = sensuous truth, which is ultimate, such as exists with natural men, even evil ones. Illustrated.
Marble = sensuous truth profaned. Explained.
